- **Archive parent:** UZ400 Ultra Fuzz
- **Builder:** Behringer
- **Catalog type:** Fuzz / Distortion
- **Identity:** Three-control fuzz/distortion stompbox with Fuzz, Tone and Level, documented by Behringer as vintage-style high-gain fuzz. [1]

- **FUZZ**
- **TONE**
- **LEVEL**
- Blue activation LED.
- On/off footswitch. [1]

- Behringer describes the UZ400 as a classic/vintage-style fuzz-distortion design.
- No specific historic clone lineage is assigned because the reviewed manufacturer source does not identify one.

- Exact production transistor/device part numbers are not publicly documented.

- Exact clipping/protection device and part number are not publicly documented.

- **9V battery** operation.
- Optional **PSU-SB** external DC supply. [1]

- No numbered electronic revision established.
- Orange enclosure is the documented standard production presentation.

Behringer positions the UZ400 around aggressive vintage grit, buzzy/saw-like attack and sustained lead tones. Fuzz controls the saturation range, Tone shapes brightness and Level sets output. [1]

Privacy Terms Accessibility Back to Products UZ400 Classic Fuzz Distortion Effects Pedal 1 / 6 Zoom View in fullscreen UZ400 Legacy Classic Fuzz Distortion Effects Pedal Share Overview Learning Features About this product Classic Fuzz Distortion Effects Pedal ULTRA FUZZ UZ400 Turn on to the pure rock satisfaction that lies within the ULTRA FUZZ UZ400—then hold tight as it morphs your amp into a volcanic weapon of mass distortion. More than just a simple blast from the past, the Ultra Fuzz churns out supercharged vintage grit, giving your riffs buzz-saw power and sustaining your leads into the ‘70s—the 2070s, that is! Easy to Dial-in Twist the dedicated Fuzz, Tone and Level dials to create a sound that's every bit as dirty as you want it to be. The blue LED tells you when it's activated and the on/off switch maintains outstanding signal integrity in bypass mode. You can power this box o' dirt with a 9 V battery or our PSU-SB DC power supply (not included). Value Primal garage-rattling fuzz awaits you in the Ultra Fuzz UZ400. It’s highly affordable—and it’s at your BEHRINGER dealer right now.
